# Biniyam Abera

> Biniyam Abera is a full-stack software engineer with a background in civil engineering, building web applications and SaaS products with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

Certifications: Meta Front-End Developer and IBM JavaScript Back-End Developer professional certificates. This site is Biniyam's portfolio, and it also runs three working systems: a retrieval-augmented AI assistant, a subscription SaaS product with Stripe billing, and a headless Shopify storefront.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction, selected work and background
- [Work](/projects): Case studies of products Biniyam designed and built
- [Creator Dashboard](/saas): A subscription SaaS that combines GitHub, YouTube and Hacker News numbers in one dashboard, with accounts and Stripe Checkout
- [Shop](/shop): A headless storefront built on the Shopify Storefront API
